title: Confidentiality Agreement
assumptions: Both sides will share prices and customer lists for the joint reporting service, so Exempel Tryck expected a mutual agreement.
Schedule 1, which the governing law clause refers to, was not sent with the agreement.

items.quote: all information disclosed by Halvard to the Recipient
items.note: Only Halvard's information is protected. Exempel Tryck will also share its prices and customer lists, which this agreement leaves unprotected.
items.proposed_change: Make the agreement mutual: each party may be the disclosing or the receiving party.

items.note: The Project is named as a possible joint reporting service.

items.quote: whether marked as confidential or not, including information disclosed orally
items.note: Wide, as the disclosing side would want; workable for the Recipient once the carve-outs are added.

items.quote: The obligations in clause 2 do not apply to information which is or becomes publicly available
items.note: Only one of the four usual carve-outs. Information Exempel Tryck already knew, develops on its own or receives from someone else without a duty of confidence stays caught.
items.proposed_change: Add the three missing carve-outs as a new clause 3.2.

items.quote: The Recipient shall be liable for any disclosure of Confidential Information, however caused.
items.note: Liability without fault, higher than the care Exempel Tryck takes with its own information.
items.proposed_change: Replace with a duty of reasonable care, no less than the care Exempel Tryck uses for its own similar information.

items.quote: to its employees who need to know it for the Project
items.note: Advisers are left out, so Exempel Tryck cannot show the agreement or the information to its accountant or lawyer.
items.proposed_change: Add professional advisers bound by a duty of confidentiality.

items.note: Covered by the strict liability point under Disclosure Obligations.

items.quote: shall not disclose it to any third party
items.note: No exception for a disclosure the law, a court or an authority requires.
items.proposed_change: Allow disclosure required by law, with notice to Halvard where the law allows.

items.quote: shall survive for a period of ten (10) years after termination
items.note: Fifteen years in all for prices that change every year.
items.proposed_change: Three years after termination, trade secrets for as long as they stay secret.

items.quote: delete all copies, including back-up copies
items.note: Backups cannot be deleted one file at a time.
items.proposed_change: Allow copies in routine backups and copies the law requires, which stay confidential.

items.note: The agreement has no residual knowledge clause.

items.quote: shall not solicit or employ any employee of Halvard
items.note: A restriction unrelated to confidentiality, and it also bars hiring someone who answers a public job advertisement.
items.proposed_change: Delete clause 7, or limit it to people Exempel Tryck met through the Project and allow general advertisements.

items.note: No warranty or disclaimer clause either way.

items.quote: a contractual penalty of NOK 500,000, without prejudice to Halvard's right to claim further damages
items.note: A fixed penalty for each breach, on top of damages, with no cap.
items.proposed_change: Delete the penalty, or make it the only remedy for the breach it covers and cap it.

items.note: The agreement says nothing about assignment.
The courts are said to be in Schedule 1, which was not sent. Ask Halvard for it before the review of this item can be finished.

items.quote: the courts set out in Schedule 1
items.note: The agreement refers to a schedule it does not contain.
items.proposed_change: Name the courts in clause 9.1 or attach Schedule 1.
